context.description: kubeconfig context name; empty means the current context.

namespace_from.description: Read the namespace from a sops-encrypted dotenv file instead: sops:<file>#<key>.

namespaces.description: Namespaces holding the environment's workloads. Set this or namespace_from.

environments.description: Environments by name (lower-case letters, digits, '-'), in the order the environment picker shows them.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.
